purpose: Stable registry for vault operators, vault frameworks, and high-signal vault instances seen in holder or borrow-flow graphs.
rules: Use this file to pin known vault identities before guessing from generic contract names.
Do not infer owner or curator beyond the listed evidence.
If evidence is weak, keep owner_or_curator as null and confidence LOW.
Gross lending positions can be much larger than vault TVL when the vault loops or rebalances across venues.

ipor_fusion.why_it_matters: Fusion PlasmaVaults can batch fuse actions across Aave, Spark, Morpho and other venues; they should be treated as strategy vaults, not simple EOAs or passive token holders.
risk_notes: A January 2026 public report described a PlasmaVault-related exploit involving a legacy EIP-7702 issue; verify whether an observed vault uses affected components before generalizing risk.
A generic PlasmaVaultBase label is framework-level evidence. Use vault name, symbol, asset, curator and current positions to identify the concrete strategy.

mellow.why_it_matters: Mellow vaults split execution across parent Vault and Subvault accounts; subvault holders should be rolled up to the parent vault/product when interpreting holder graphs.
risk_notes: Do not label a Subvault as a separate end-user holder; identify parent_vault and share_manager first.

etherfi_boringvault.why_it_matters: BoringVault receipts such as liquidETH can hold or route through Aave/Spark receipt tokens; interpret as managed vault product exposure rather than a simple wallet.
risk_notes: Current owner/authority should be re-read before making governance or control claims.

veda_golden_goose.why_it_matters: GG is a BoringVault receipt for the Lido Golden Goose Vault product. In holder graphs, treat the vault itself as the relevant managed product exposure; expanding GG token shareholders usually adds noise.
risk_notes: Vault allocation and deposit status should be re-read before making current portfolio claims.
The GG token represents shares of the vault; holder expansion is not the same as strategy allocation.

inheritable_vault.why_it_matters: InheritableVault contracts are upgradeable general wallets with dead-man-switch ownership transfer. Treat them as controlled custody wallets, not DeFi strategy vaults or passive EOAs.
risk_notes: The contract exposes owner-only arbitrary execution and ERC20 transfer functions.
Owner and inheritor addresses are account-level control evidence only; do not infer real-world identity without separate evidence.
